data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Mooring County Back in Warden Hands; Stonecradle Sees Fresh Flips
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the last edition, Mooring County has changed again: the Colonial strongpoint reported there is gone, and the county’s twelve positions stand Warden all. The freshest movement centers on Stonecradle, where five base events were logged in the latest two-hour window and the split reads five Colonial to four Warden; World’s End led that region’s daily tally with ten events. Weathered Expanse keeps a five-to-four Colonial edge and remains the heaviest daily battleground, with twenty-seven events logged in the past day, though the final two hours brought no flip. Linn Mercy stays ten Colonial to one Warden, all fifteen of its daily flips at Lathair. Stlican Shelf is still five Warden, four Colonial, with Thornhold the busiest point. Fisherman’s Row, after thirty-two daily flips, has quieted into nine Colonial strongpoints. Callahan’s Passage, Nevish Line, and Dead Lands post heavy casualty lists without recorded strategic-base changes. No victor has been declared.
